We summarise quadrat AGB density, from error propagation and from the sum
of stem AGB, and map it in each plot. The two estimates
differ where trees without coordinates are placed at random, and because
measurement errors are not symmetric on the AGB scale. In the automated
workflow these figures are written to `report/` by `10_quad_summ.R`. It also
writes versions across the whole site, for sites with several plots: maps of
quadrat AGBD and stem AGB in longitude and latitude
(`10_quad_agbd_map_site.png`, `10_stem_agb_map_site.png`), and quadrat AGBD
with its 95% interval for all quadrats of the site
(`10_quad_agbd_interval_site.png`). With a single plot in the example these
repeat the figures of each plot, so they are not shown here.

```{r}
#| tab-cap: "Summary of quadrat AGB density (Mg/ha, simulated mean)."
# Summarise quadrat AGB density, from error propagation (mc) and from the sum
# of stem AGB. They differ where trees without coordinates are assigned to
# quadrats at random, and because measurement errors are not symmetric on the
# AGB scale
quad_check <- st_drop_geometry(quad_summ) %>%
  mutate(
    cv_pct = 100 * agbd_Mg_ha_mc_sd / agbd_Mg_ha_mc_mean,
    diff_pct = 100 * (agbd_Mg_ha_mc_mean - agb_Mg_sum_ha) / agb_Mg_sum_ha)

quad_check_summ <- quad_check %>%
  summarise(
    n_quadrat = n(),
    n_empty = sum(n_stem == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    area_ha_median = median(quadrat_area_ha),
    agbd_min = min(agbd_Mg_ha_mc_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    agbd_median = median(agbd_Mg_ha_mc_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    agbd_max = max(agbd_Mg_ha_mc_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_pct_median = median(cv_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_diff_over_10pct = sum(abs(diff_pct) > 10, na.rm = TRUE))

kable(quad_check_summ, digits = 2)
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Map of quadrat AGB density in each plot."
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Quadrat AGB density from error propagation (simulated mean with 95% interval) against the sum of stem AGB. The dashed line shows 1:1. Quadrats whose 95% interval is above the 1:1 line are labelled."
#| fig-width: 7.5

# Figure comparing quadrat AGB density from error propagation and from the

quad_lim <- range(c(quad_check$agb_Mg_sum_ha, quad_check$agbd_Mg_ha_mc_ci2.5,
  quad_check$agbd_Mg_ha_mc_ci97.5), na.rm = TRUE)
# Quadrats where the 95% interval is entirely above the 1:1 line, e.g. with

quad_above <- filter(quad_check, agbd_Mg_ha_mc_ci2.5 > agb_Mg_sum_ha)
p_quad_comp <- ggplot(quad_check, aes(x = agb_Mg_sum_ha, y = agbd_Mg_ha_mc_mean)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, colour = fig_pal$ink_muted,

    colour = fig_pal$series[1], alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.4) +

  # Labels are moved apart so that they do not overlap

  coord_equal(xlim = quad_lim, ylim = quad_lim) +
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Quadrat AGB density with its 95% interval from error propagation, quadrats ranked within each plot."

n_plot_rank <- length(unique(quad_rank$plot_id))
# Lines and points are scaled to the width available for each quadrat in the

  max(table(quad_rank$plot_id))
p_quad_int <- ggplot(quad_rank, aes(x = rank)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = agbd_Mg_ha_mc_ci2.5, ymax = agbd_Mg_ha_mc_ci97.5),
    colour = fig_pal$seq[3], linewidth = min(2.2, max(0.2, 0.1 * quad_slot_mm))) +
  geom_point(aes(y = agbd_Mg_ha_mc_mean), colour = fig_pal$seq[6],
    size = min(4.5, max(0.3, 0.2 * quad_slot_mm))) +
  facet_wrap(vars(plotFactor(plot_id)), ncol = figCols(n_plot_rank), 
    scales = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    title = "Quadrat AGBD with 95% interval",
    x = "Quadrats, ranked by AGBD",
    y = "AGBD (Mg/ha)") +
  themeFig() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
p_quad_int
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Map of the coefficient of variation of quadrat AGB density in each plot."
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Map of stem AGB in each plot, for stems used to estimate AGB density, with the quadrats, relative to the south-west of each plot."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8
# Figures of stem AGB, for stems used to estimate AGB density, across the
# site in longitude and latitude, and in each plot, relative to the 
# south-west of the quadrat grid of each plot as in the map of quadrat AGB
# density
stem_map <- stem_summ %>%
  filter(in_quadrat_calc %in% TRUE, !st_is_empty(.), !is.na(agb_Mg), agb_Mg > 0) %>%
  mutate(plot_id = as.character(plot_id)) %>%
  arrange(agb_Mg)
# The lightest colour of the ramp is not used, so that stems with little AGB
# stay visible
stem_agb_colour <- scale_colour_gradientn("Stem AGB (Mg)", colours = fig_pal$seq2[-1],
  trans = "log10", breaks = 10^(-3:3),
  labels = function(x) format(x, drop0trailing = TRUE, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
  guide = colourBar())

quad_xy0 <- quad_xy %>%
  group_by(plot_id) %>%
  summarise(x0 = min(X), y0 = min(Y), .groups = "drop")
stem_map_xy <- stem_map %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(plot_id %in% quad_xy0$plot_id) %>%
  localXY(., "x_utm", "y_utm", "plot_id", quad_xy0)
p_stem_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_blank(data = squareExtent(quad_xy_local, "X", "Y", "plot_id"),

p_stem_map
```

Then we can create the L1, L2 and L3 GEO-TREES tree inventory data products.

Each data product has an associated
[RO-Crate](https://www.researchobject.org/ro-crate/) manifest file in the same
directory (`*_ro-crate-metadata.json`), which records the version of the code and
the input data sources so they can be reproduced. These files are created
programmatically in R using the `rocrateR` package. The RO-Crate format is
flexible so you can add additional information as needed to reproduce the
output data product. 

Below is the contents of an example RO-Crate file for the L3 tree inventory
(INV) quadrat-level AGBD estimates. It specifies the input data, the version of
the INV_processing GitHub repository containing the code, and the output data
product. It includes meta-data describing each input and output dataset,
meta-data on who executed the workflow and when. 

```{r}
rocrate_example <- rocrateR::read_rocrate("./data-raw/data/ro-crate-metadata.json")

print(rocrate_example)
```

For the tree inventory data we also include a copy of the `param.yaml` file to
record the parameters used by that PRODUCTVERSION.

These are the official GEO-TREES tree inventory data products:

* L1 re-formatted stem measurements.
* L1 re-formatted plot geo-location points
* L1 re-formatted plot meta-data
* L2 stem AGB estimates.
* L2 plot polygons.
* L3 AGBD estimates within plot quadrats.

First we create the data objects.

```{r}
L1_stem <- stem_summ %>% 
  st_transform(., 4326) %>% 
  bind_cols(., st_coordinates(.)) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    BRM_site = site_id,
    Acquisition = acquisition_id,
    Plot_name = plot_id,
    Measurement_date = measurement_date,
    Tree_label = tree_id,
    Stem_label = stem_id,
    Botany_genus = genusAccepted,
    Botany_species = speciesAccepted,
    Botany_author = authorAccepted,
    Botany_family = familyAccepted,
    Position_x = x_rel_m,
    Position_y = y_rel_m,
    Longitude = X,
    Latitude = Y,
    Diameter = diam_cm,
    POM = pom_m,
    Total_height = height_m,
    Code = code)

# Prepare L1 GNSS dataset
L1_pt <- L0$pt

# Prepare L1 plot meta-data 
L1_plot <- L0$plot

# Prepare L2 stems dataset
L2_stem <- stem_summ %>% 
  filter(in_quadrat_calc == TRUE) %>% 
  st_transform(., 4326) %>% 
  bind_cols(., st_coordinates(.)) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  mutate(
    agb_Mg_mean = ifelse(is.na(agb_Mg_mean), agb_Mg, agb_Mg_mean)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    BRM_site = site_id,
    Acquisition = acquisition_id,
    Plot_name = plot_id,
    Measurement_date = measurement_date,
    Tree_label = tree_id,
    Stem_label = stem_id,
    Longitude = X,
    Latitude = Y,
    WD_stem_estimate = meanWD,
    WD_stem_uncertainty = sdWD,
    AGB_tree_estimate = agb_Mg_mean,
    AGB_tree_uncertainty = agb_Mg_sd,
    Height_stem_estimate = height_m_pred,
    Height_stem_uncertainty = height_m_pred_rse)

# Prepare L2 plot polygons dataset 
L2_poly <- plot_poly %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    BRM_site = site_id,
    Acquisition = acquisition_id,
    Plot_name = plot_id)

# Check all values filled
stopifnot(all(!is.na(L2_stem$AGB_tree_estimate)))
stopifnot(all(!is.na(L2_stem$AGB_tree_uncertainty)))

# Prepare L3 quadrat dataset
# Select parameters to copy as columns
param_fil <- param
param_fil$quadrat_dim_x_m <- param_fil$quad_dim[1]
param_fil$quadrat_dim_y_m <- param_fil$quad_dim[2]
param_fil[["quad_dim"]] <- NULL
if (param_fil$opt_s3) { 
  param_fil[["raw_dir"]] <- param_fil$s3_dir
} 
param_fil[c("site_id", "acquisition_id", "out_dir", "quad_dim", "s3_dir", "opt_s3", "rocrate", "als_date", "quad_origin", "missing_diam_method")] <- NULL
# Parameters with several or named values, e.g. `height_custom`, as one
# column each, see `paramString()` in func.R
param_fil <- lapply(param_fil, paramString)

L3_quad <- quad_summ %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    BRM_site = site_id,
    Acquisition = acquisition_id,
    Plot_name = plot_id,
    Census_date = census_date,
    Quadrat_name = quadrat_id,
    AGBD_stand_estimate = agbd_Mg_ha_mc_mean,
    AGBD_stand_uncertainty = agbd_Mg_ha_mc_sd,
    Height_stand_estimate = height_m_pred_max,
    Height_stand_uncertainty = height_m_pred_max_rse,
    Basal_area = ba_m2_sum_ha,
    Lorey_height = lorey_height_m,
    Wood_density = meanWD_wm_ba,
    Quadrat_area = quadrat_area_ha,
    # Crown-distributed AGB density, if `crown_method` is not "none"
    AGBD_crown_estimate = any_of("agbd_Mg_ha_crown_mc_mean"),
    AGBD_crown_uncertainty = any_of("agbd_Mg_ha_crown_mc_sd")) %>%
  bind_cols(param_fil)

# Check all values filled
stopifnot(all(!is.na(L3_quad$AGBD_stand_estimate)))

# Check not all AGBD estimates should be zero
stopifnot(!all(L3_quad$AGBD_stand_estimate == 0))
```

Then we create the filenames and output directories for the data objects, which
are a concatenation of the following values, matching the order of the
GEO-TREES directory hierarchy.

```{r}
# Create sanitised software version string for filenames
software_version_sanit <- gsub("\\.", "-", param$software_version)

# Construct output filenames
L1_filename <- paste(
    param$site_id, 
    "INV", 
    param$acquisition_id, 
    param$product_version,
    software_version_sanit, 
    "L1", 
  sep = "_")

L2_filename <- paste(
    param$site_id, 
    "INV", 
    param$acquisition_id, 
    param$product_version,
    software_version_sanit, 
    "L2", 
  sep = "_")

L3_filename <- paste(
    param$site_id, 
    "INV", 
    param$acquisition_id, 
    param$product_version,
    software_version_sanit, 
    "L3", 
  sep = "_")

# Create output directories
L_list <- c("L1", "L2", "L3")
L_dir_list <- lapply(L_list, function(x) { 
  file.path(param$out_dir, software_version_sanit, x)
})
names(L_dir_list) <- L_list
```

Then we can write the data objects to files:

```{r}
#| eval: false
lapply(L_dir_list, dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Write L1 dataset to file
write.csv(L1_stem, file.path(L_dir_list[["L1"]], paste0(L1_filename, "_stem", ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(L1_plot, file.path(L_dir_list[["L1"]], paste0(L1_filename, "_plot", ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(L1_pt, file.path(L_dir_list[["L1"]], paste0(L1_filename, "_pt", ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

# Write L2 dataset to file
write.csv(L2_stem, file.path(L_dir_list[["L2"]], paste0(L2_filename, "_stem", ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
st_write(L2_poly , file.path(L_dir_list[["L2"]], paste0(L2_filename, "_poly", ".gpkg")), delete_dsn = TRUE) 

# Write L3 dataset to file
st_write(L3_quad, file.path(L_dir_list[["L3"]], paste0(L3_filename, "_quad", ".gpkg")), delete_dsn = TRUE)
```

Finally, we can construct the RO-Crate files which sit alongside each data
product. The author, affiliation, and license are taken from the `rocrate`
section of `param.yaml`. If `author_orcid` is provided, it is used as the
identifier of the author.

```{r}
# Construct RO-crates
# Author, affiliation and license are defined in param.yaml

# Create local RO-Crate identifier from a name
rocrateId <- function(x) {
  paste0("#", gsub("^-|-$", "", gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(x))))
}

# Author, identified by ORCID if provided
me <- entity(
  x = if (!is.null(param$rocrate$author_orcid)) {
    param$rocrate$author_orcid 
  } else { 
    rocrateId(param$rocrate$author_name)
  },
  type = "Person",
  name = param$rocrate$author_name,
  email = param$rocrate$author_email
)

# Affiliation
aff <- entity(
  x = rocrateId(param$rocrate$affiliation),
  type = "Organization",
  name = param$rocrate$affiliation
)

# License
lic <- entity(
  x = param$rocrate$license,
  type = c("File", "CreativeWork") 
)

# Input directory
indir <- entity(
  x = paste0(param$raw_dir, "/"),
  type = "Dataset",
  description = "Directory containing raw L0 data."
)

# Output files
L1_stem_outfile <- entity(
  x = file.path(L_dir_list[["L1"]], paste0(L1_filename, "_stem", ".csv")),
  type = "File",
  description = "L1 re-formatted stem measurements.",
  encodingFormat = "text/csv"
)

L1_pt_outfile <- entity(
  x = file.path(L_dir_list[["L1"]], paste0(L1_filename, "_pt", ".csv")),
  type = "File",
  description = "L1 re-formatted plot geo-location points",
  encodingFormat = "text/csv"
)

L1_plot_outfile <- entity(
  x = file.path(L_dir_list[["L1"]], paste0(L1_filename, "_plot", ".csv")),
  type = "File",
  description = "L1 re-formatted plot meta-data",
  encodingFormat = "text/csv"
)

L2_stem_outfile <- entity(
  x = file.path(L_dir_list[["L2"]], paste0(L2_filename, "_stem", ".csv")),
  type = "File",
  description = "L2 stem AGB estimates.",
  encodingFormat = "text/csv"
)

L2_poly_outfile <- entity(
  x = file.path(L_dir_list[["L2"]], paste0(L2_filename, "_poly", ".gpkg")),
  type = "File",
  description = "L2 plot polygons.",
  encodingFormat = "application/geopackage+sqlite3"
)


L3_quad_outfile <- entity(
  x = file.path(L_dir_list[["L3"]], paste0(L3_filename, "_quad", ".gpkg")),
  type = "File",
  description = "L3 AGBD estimates within plot quadrats.",
  encodingFormat = "application/geopackage+sqlite3"
)

# Parameters file
yaml <- entity(
  x = "param.yaml",
  type = "File",
  description = "Configuration parameters.",
  encodingFormat = "application/yaml"
)

# Software 
code <- entity(
  x = paste0("#INV_processing_", param$software_version),
  type = c("SoftwareApplication", "SoftwareSourceCode"),
  name = "GEO-TREES AGBD processing pipeline",
  version = param$software_version,
  url = paste0("https://github.com/GEO-TREES/INV_processing/releases/tag/", param$software_version),
  programmingLanguage = "R"
)

# Execution action
exec <- entity(
  x = "#run-tree_inventory_pipeline",
  type = "CreateAction",
  name = "Tree inventory pipeline execution",
  description = "Execute tree inventory pipeline to generate data products",
  endTime = strftime(Sys.time(), format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC")
)

L_outfile_list <- list(
  "L1" = list(
    "L1_stem" = L1_stem_outfile,
    "L1_plot" = L1_plot_outfile,
    "L1_pt" = L1_pt_outfile
  ),
  "L2" = list(
    "L2_stem" = L2_stem_outfile,
    "L2_poly" = L2_poly_outfile
  ),
  "L3" = list(
    "L3_quad" = L3_quad_outfile
  )
)

# Initialize crates, add entities and relationships
rocrate_list <- lapply(names(L_outfile_list), function(x) { 
  rc <- rocrate(
    context = "https://w3id.org/ro/crate/1.2/context",
    datePublished = as.character(Sys.Date()),
    name = paste("GEO-TREES", param$site_id, "INV", x)
  ) %>%
    add_entity(me) %>%
    add_entity(aff) %>%
    add_entity(lic) %>%
    add_entity(indir) %>%
    add_entity(yaml) %>%
    add_entity(code) %>%
    add_entity(exec)

  for (i in L_outfile_list[[x]]) {
    rc <- rc %>% add_entity(i)
  }

  L_outfile_id_list <- unname(lapply(L_outfile_list[[x]], function(i) { 
    list(`@id` = i$`@id`) 
  }))

  rc %>%
    add_entity_value(id = "./", key = "author", value = list(`@id` = me$`@id`)) %>%
    add_entity_value(id = "./", key = "license", value = list(`@id` = lic$`@id`)) %>%
    add_entity_value(id = "./", key = "hasPart", 
      value = c(
        list(
          list(`@id` = yaml$`@id`),
          list(`@id` = indir$`@id`),
          list(`@id` = lic$`@id`)
        ),
        L_outfile_id_list
      )
    ) %>%
    add_entity_value(id = "./", key = "mentions", value = list(
        list(`@id` = exec$`@id`),
        list(`@id` = code$`@id`)
      )) %>%
    add_entity_value(id = me$`@id`, key = "affiliation", value = list(`@id` = aff$`@id`)) %>%
    add_entity_value(id = exec$`@id`, key = "object", 
      value = list(
        list(`@id` = yaml$`@id`),
        list(`@id` = indir$`@id`)
      )) %>%
    add_entity_value(id = exec$`@id`, key = "result", value = L_outfile_id_list) %>%
    add_entity_value(id = exec$`@id`, key = "instrument", value = list(`@id` = code$`@id`))
})
names(rocrate_list) <- names(L_outfile_list)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
# Write crates to file
lapply(names(rocrate_list), function(x) { 
  write_rocrate(rocrate_list[[x]], 
    file.path(L_dir_list[[x]], "ro-crate-metadata.json"))
})

# Copy param.yaml to each data output
lapply(L_dir_list, function(x) { 
  file.copy("./param.yaml", file.path(x, "param.yaml"))
})
```

## Next steps

The L3 tree inventory data product is passed to the AGBD geo-spatial modelling
workflow to produce landscape-level estimates of AGBD at 50x50 m gridded
resolution, in combination with the ALS L3 data products.
